title: Show detailed file information like size and dates
summary: Use the stat command to see detailed metadata about a file, including its size, permissions, and various timestamps (access, modification, change).

steps.explain: Run stat with the path to the file you want to inspect. It prints a detailed report including size, permissions, and timestamps.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to inspect

steps.expect: A list of file properties such as Size, Access, Modify, Change, and Permissions.
